scope: Real Chromium, production backup UI, HTTP routes, protected config store and secret restoration. Synthetic DB/auth/module status and commands. Strict self-only script/style CSP imposed by fixture. No backup worker or hardware.

checks.name: source and destination cards are separate; automatic EOS PostgreSQL history explained; no advanced editor DOM until opened
all 228 existing config properties and 9 optional fields remain reachable; closed dialogs release their fields
independent card switches and dialog Apply edit only the draft; Cancel, close and Escape discard only dialog edits and restore focus
single full save uses production CSRF route and encrypted revision store; untouched secrets, nested markers, unknown fields and unselected notification channels are preserved
saved-secret marker is blank and preserved; explicit replacement and explicit clear work, while Cancel discards a clear
invalid JSON stays inside its dialog without applying or losing the existing unknown customer object
background status refresh preserves a live dialog and draft revision; concurrent committed change causes CAS conflict without overwriting draft
validation, session expiry, role loss and CSRF rejection leave unsaved switches intact; retry after restored authority saves the same draft
SD-card discovery still uses the guarded production command route and populates only the local-target dialog
390px mobile and 1024px tablet keep modal within viewport, focus inside, Escape restores opener and controls meet 44px target height

editorDom.previousEagerEditorRule: One form editor for every configuration property, including all advanced values
editorDom.scope: DOM field count only; no process RAM benchmark.
